name: Marriott Executive Apartments Danang, Han River
short_description: Marriott Executive Apartments Danang, Han River is a five-star extended-stay serviced residence in the central M Landmark Tower on Da Nang's riverfront, with fully equipped kitchen apartments and river views.
ai_summary: Marriott Executive Apartments Danang, Han River is the first Marriott Executive Apartments in Vietnam, occupying the upper floors of the glass-clad M Landmark Tower on Bach Dang Street in central Da Nang. It offers 91 serviced apartments in studio, one-bedroom and two-bedroom layouts, each with a fully equipped kitchen, in-room washer-dryer and views over the Han River or city — a product aimed at extended stays, relocating professionals and families who prefer to self-cater. The setting is a clear strength: it sits directly on the riverfront within a short walk of Han Market, Da Nang Cathedral and the Dragon Bridge, and roughly ten minutes by car from Da Nang International Airport. Facilities include indoor and outdoor swimming pools, a fitness studio, a lobby lounge, an espresso bar and an all-day dining restaurant, with the M45 Rooftop Bar providing cocktails and panoramic views; several of these amenities are shared with the co-located Courtyard by Marriott Danang Han River in the same tower. Because the residence opened only in 2026, independent guest reviews and its TripAdvisor sample are still minimal, so long-term service consistency and housekeeping standards are not yet well established. Bookers should also note that, as an extended-stay serviced-apartment brand, on-site dining and resort-style facilities are more limited than at a full resort, and the property is a central-city riverfront address rather than a beachfront one, sitting about three kilometres from My Khe Beach across the river.

faqs.question: Where is Marriott Executive Apartments Danang, Han River located?
faqs.answer: It sits at 58 Bach Dang Street in the Hai Chau district, on Da Nang's central Han River waterfront inside the M Landmark Tower. Guests are within a short walk of Han Market, Da Nang Cathedral and the Dragon Bridge, and roughly ten minutes by car from Da Nang International Airport.

faqs.question: How is it different from a normal hotel?
faqs.answer: It is an extended-stay serviced-apartment residence, the first Marriott Executive Apartments in Vietnam. Its 91 studio, one- and two-bedroom apartments include fully equipped kitchens and in-room washer-dryers, making them suited to long stays, relocating professionals and families who prefer to self-cater rather than rely solely on restaurant dining.

faqs.question: What facilities are available on site?
faqs.answer: Residents can use indoor and outdoor swimming pools, a fitness studio, a lobby lounge, an espresso bar and an all-day dining restaurant. The M45 Rooftop Bar offers cocktails with panoramic river views. Several facilities are shared with the co-located Courtyard by Marriott Danang Han River in the same tower.
